description: Default editable exercise library for IronStart. Keep IDs stable when editing so workout history remains linked.

exercises.name: Barbell squat
exercises.instruction: Brace your trunk, keep the bar balanced over mid-foot, and use a controlled, pain-free depth.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.instruction: Keep shoulders stable, lower with control, and use a spotter or correctly set safety arms.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.instruction: Brace the abdomen and glutes. Press overhead without turning the lift into a backbend.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instruction: Keep the bar close, brace before each rep, and reset your position between repetitions.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.instruction: Hinge at the hips and keep your torso position stable as you row toward your lower ribs.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instruction: Use a controlled range and keep your wrists stacked above your elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.instruction: Use a light load, lift with control, and avoid swinging the torso.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.instruction: Keep elbows near your sides and move through a controlled range.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.instruction: Pull toward the upper chest without using momentum or leaning far backward.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.instruction: Pull toward eye level with elbows out and finish with controlled shoulder rotation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.instruction: Keep upper arms still and lower the dumbbells without dropping the weight.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instruction: Push hips back with a soft knee bend, keep the load close, and stop before your back position changes.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instruction: Use a controlled depth while keeping hips and lower back supported by the pad.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.instruction: Move smoothly and avoid bouncing the weight stack.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.instruction: Use a comfortable full range, pause briefly at the top, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.instruction: Hold the weight close to your chest and squat through a pain-free range.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.instruction: Keep the body in one line and choose an incline or range that lets you control every rep.
